description: Points Routiers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Saint-Denis (La Réunion). Location of the different Road Points (PR) in Saint-Denis. Coverage: the commune of Saint-Denis on La Réunion (bounding box 55.377 to 55.505 degrees east, 20.903 to 20.873 degrees south, as given on the data.gouv.fr page). The portal shows the English title as "Road Points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the data.gouv.fr page is Mairie de Saint-Denis (La Réunion); the European portal listing shows an unfilled template field in place of the name. Its keywords include point-routier, geospatial, saintdenis, territoire, saint-denis. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, WEB PAGE, ZIP, XLSX. The listing shows 2020-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
